title: UAP activity at nuclear sites
place_text: Pantex, Texas; Hanford, Washington, USA; Fukushima, Japan

tellings.quote: concerted correlation between um UFO or UAP activity and nuclear sites the pantac site in uh Texas and the Hanford plutonium production Facility have numerous UFO um sightings and correlations and in fact there this extends to overseas sites even the Fukushima incident had um had correlations

plain: UFO sightings tend to cluster around nuclear sites. That is the claim of Karl Nell, a retired US Army colonel who speaks as a former official, talking to Jesse Michels. He uses the term UAP, the government's newer word for UFOs. He names Pantex, a nuclear weapons plant in Texas, and Hanford, a plutonium production site in Washington state, as places with many sightings. He says the pattern reaches overseas too, and that even the Fukushima nuclear disaster in Japan had sightings linked to it, which would suggest whatever is behind them takes a special interest in nuclear material.
